BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adjunct faculty salaries; and adding a newsection to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each institution of higher education, as defined in RCW28B.10.016, shall determine a salary standard for adjunct facultymembers employed in each academic, technical, basic studies, or otherdepartment that, subject to collective bargaining with the exclusiverepresentatives of faculty where they exist, constitutes a pro ratasalary compared to the salaries of fulltime tenured faculty members ofcomparable qualifications doing comparable work. (2) By December 2009, each institution of higher education shalldetermine the method by which prorated salaries for adjunct facultywill be determined and create a plan for equitably increasingindividual salaries, taking into account experience within theinstitution as well as qualifications.
